values.note: Standard electric sites $42 a night in the 2026 peak season (Apr 15 - Oct 31) and the 2027 one (Apr 5 - Nov 14); tent-only sites $26 (non-electric) and $30 (electric), group tent area $120. No off-peak rate has been listed since 2023.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232575/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season price maps: STANDARD ELECTRIC 42, TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 26, TENT ONLY ELECTRIC 30, group 120), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json + https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232575 (bookable STANDARD ELECTRIC sites: Electricity Hookup 50 at most, 20/30/50 at 01-05 and H-1/H-2, 30 at 14, 21-23, 25, 26, 41-44, 46; Water Hookup Yes at every RV site; Sewer Hookup only at the unreservable MANAGEMENT sites 15-17), read 2026-10-29

values.note: recreation.gov describes '68 campsites' but books 49: 35 standard electric RV sites, 1 tent-only electric, 12 tent-only non-electric and a group tent area; 19 more are management/hidden. Every standard electric site is listed for 25 ft or more (most 40 ft, site 25 at 55 ft); 27 of them name an RV or trailer of 25 ft+ in their permitted equipment. Pull-throughs at 01, 03, 08 and H-1.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232575 + RIDB catalog (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry, reservable flag per site) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232575 ('offering 68 campsites to choose from'), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232575 ('Flush toilets, showers and drinking water are provided. Additional amenities include a children's playground and a dump station.'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 'ALL CAMPERS MUST HAVE A RESERVATION BEFORE ENTERING CAMPGROUND'; campers self-register at the gatehouse, no transactions there. 14 days in any 30 at Carters Lake (36 CFR 327.7B). Max 8 people, 2 vehicles and 1 boat per site.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232575 (notices; facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 nights rolling 30 days), read 2026-10-29

note: USACE Mobile District, Carters Lake. Heavily wooded peninsula campground with its own boat ramp; recreation.gov warns the access road has a steep downhill grade. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov listing, rates and per-site catalog: $42 standard electric (2026 and 2027 peak), reservations required (fcfs never), 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night max; 50 A + water (no public sewer); 49 bookable sites (35 RV), max 55 ft, pull-throughs; flush toilets, showers, water, dump.
